title: Derived restriction of scalars is termwise
statement:
In the situation of [lem-sfb-extend-scalars-kflat], there is a canonical
isomorphism $R(\operatorname{Res}_\varphi)\cong D(\operatorname{Res}_\varphi)$ between the
right derived restriction of scalars and the functor
$D(\Mod_{\mathcal S})\to D(\Mod_{\mathcal R})$ that restricts scalars termwise.

proof.text:
Kernels and cokernels of module objects are computed on the underlying objects, both for
$\mathcal R$- and for $\mathcal S$-modules, so $\operatorname{Res}_\varphi$ preserves finite
limits and finite colimits, i.e. it is exact [sk-def-sfb-change-of-scalars]. The right
derived functor of an exact functor is the termwise functor
[sk-def-sfb-derived-categories].
